Name: Joshah, Son of Amaziah
Summary: Son of Amaziah, prince of Simeon named among those whose families increased.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:34: Son of Amaziah, prince of Simeon named among those whose families increased.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joshah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
